_provenance.source: Generated from Iloilo SUMO net bounding box (iloilo.net.xml); CR-007 PR 7.
_provenance.tier_rationale: All cells are M (conservative overall simulation confidence). Data inputs CCHAIN/OSM/LIPAD are H, but uncalibrated mode-share (PR 9) and literature-calibrated methods cap most results at M (methods §2 method_capped_confidence rule, ratified CR-007 PR 6). BEH-1/BEH-3 and ECO-1 are H along the network corridors; a spatially-varying H/M grid requires a network-edge intersection pass not yet wired — uniform M is the honest floor until calibration lands (PR 9).
